Data Entry Operator, Supply Chain - B2B Job at Flour Mills of Nigeria Plc




        
    

        
        Flour Mills of Nigeria Plc has been a part of the lives of Nigerians at home and abroad. Our global vision is to be a leading foods company in Africa providing high quality and affordable products in the most convenient ways to consumers through world class brands like Golden Penny Flour, Golden Penny Semovita, Goldenvita, Golden Pasta and Golden Noodles. The Company's flagship brand, Golden Penny, remains one of the best known and the preferred brands amongst bakers, confectioneries and consumers in Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Data Entry Operator, Supply Chain - B2B 

Job Location: Apapa, Lagos

Purpose
     

            
    




	To accurately create, process, and post waybills and invoices, ensure timely dispatch documentation, accurate data entry, and seamless logistics operations in line with company quality standards and procedures.


The Job


	Generate waybills and invoices for loaded trucks accurately and within required timelines.
	Ensure accurate capture and processing of dispatch data, including product SKUs, quantities, and delivery details.
	Verify gate passes and conduct status checks prior to processing loading documentation.
	Prevent invalid or zero-value dispatch transactions through diligent verification processes.
	Maintain high levels of accuracy in all waybill and invoice documentation.
	Prepare and submit operational reports to support efficient delivery and logistics activities.
	Ensure compliance with company Quality Management System (QMS) requirements and established operating procedures.
	Identify and escalate discrepancies relating to gate passes, invoicing, and delivery documentation.
	Collaborate with Sales, Production, Internal Audit, IT, and Logistics teams to facilitate smooth operations.


Requirements
Qualification:


	5 O’Level credits, including Mathematics and English.


Experience:


	Minimum of two (2) years of experience in data entry, logistics administration, dispatch operations, or a related role.
	Experience working with invoicing systems, waybill processing, or logistics documentation is desirable.


The Person Must:


	Be computer literate and possess strong data entry skills.
	Demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
	Have good numerical and record-keeping abilities
	Possess strong organizational and time-management skills and ability to run shift.

Security Operation Manager Job at Latins Security Limited




        
    

        
        Latins Security Company - We are a private security company, established by a team of highly skilled and dedicated security professionals to tackle and provide total security solutions for individuals as well as private and government organizations. 

Latins Security Nigeria Limited is affiliated to Latins Security UK Limited (now Stone House Security Solutions Limited. As an independent company focused on providing quality security services, we pride ourselves on providing the highest quality security personnel and solutions that are tailored to our clients’ specific requirements.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Security Operation Manager
Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time 

Key Responsibilities


	Oversee daily security operations across all client sites and contracts in Abuja and environs
	Manage scheduling, deployment, and supervision of security personnel and supervisors
	Develop, implement, and enforce operational procedures, security protocols, and safety standards
	Conduct regular site inspections, patrols audits, and compliance checks
	Serve as the primary point of contact for client relationships, addressing concerns and escalations promptly
	Recruit, train, mentor, and evaluate security supervisors and guards
	Lead incident response, investigations, and reporting
	Monitor operational budgets, payroll, equipment, and logistics
	Ensure full compliance with licensing requirements, labor laws, and industry regulations
	Prepare and present operational reports and performance metrics to senior management
	Build and maintain a culture of discipline, accountability, and excellence across the workforce


Requirements


	Candidates should possess a Bachelor’s Degree / HND
	Minimum of 5 years of experience as an Operations Manager within a security company (required)
	Military background required* — veterans, ex-servicemen, and retired officers are strongly encouraged to apply
	Demonstrated leadership and personnel management experience, ideally involving large or multi-site teams
	Strong knowledge of security operations, risk assessment, threat management, and emergency response procedures
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and client-relationship skills
	Sound understanding of Nigerian security regulations and licensing requirements
	Strong organizational and reporting skills
	Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and on-call as needed
	Clean record and verifiable references from previous employment.


Preferred Qualifications:


	Officer or senior NCO leadership experience in the Nigerian Armed Forces, Police, or similar
	Relevant certifications (e.g., security management, risk management, or related professional courses)
	Experience managing large-scale or high-profile security contracts (corporate, government, or residential estates)
	Familiarity with modern security technology (CCTV, access control, GPS tracking, etc.)


What We Offer


	Competitive salary commensurate with experience
	A leadership role in one of Abuja's top security firms
	Opportunity to shape and strengthen operational standards
	Career growth within a reputable and expanding company


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a cover letter detailing their relevant military and security management experience to: [email protected] using "Operations Manager" as the subject of the mail.

Bank Officer Job at Addoz Integrated Resources




        
    

        
        Addoz Integrated Resources - Our client is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Bank Officer
Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time 

Job Summary


	Our client is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Bank Officer to join their finance team. The ideal candidate should have a strong accounting background, with several years of relevant experience in accounting and banking operations.
	The candidate must have a good understanding of financial transactions, bank reconciliations, cash management, and general accounting procedures.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Manage daily banking transactions and financial activities.
	Prepare and maintain accurate bank and financial records.
	Perform regular bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies.
	Monitor cash inflows, outflows, and account balances.
	Process payments, transfers, deposits, and other banking transactions.
	Liaise with banks on account-related issues and transactions.
	Prepare financial and banking reports for management review.
	Ensure proper documentation and authorization of all financial transactions.
	Support the accounts team with financial reporting and other accounting duties.
	Ensure compliance with internal financial policies and relevant banking regulations.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree / HND in Accounting, Finance, Banking & Finance, or a related field.
	4–6 years of relevant experience in accounting, finance, or banking operations.
	Strong accounting background with proven experience in bank reconciliation and financial reporting.
	Professional accounting certification such as ACCA, ICAN, or equivalent is an added advantage.
	Good knowledge of banking operations, financial transactions, and accounting principles.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting/ERP software.
	Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	High level of accuracy, integrity, and attention to detail.
	Candidates with experience in both accounting and banking operations will be highly preferred.


Salary
N250,000 - N300,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using “Bank Officer – Lekki” as the subject of the email.
